findings.evidence: "Before handoff, record a baseline: `git status --short`" is followed by "re-run the baseline command ... and compare" on line 35. In an already-dirty worktree, Codex can change an already-modified or untracked source file without changing its status entry, so this branch can miss prohibited source edits.
findings.fix: Record a content-aware baseline before handoff: file paths and content hashes, including already-modified and untracked files. Compare file presence and hashes after Codex returns, excluding only the chosen plan file. Keep `git status --short` as a summary rather than the change-verification mechanism.
